Subject: Re: Live demo failures — initial triage and temporary mitigations

Quick triage summary (prelim):
- Observed backlog on the proxy layer when handling multiplexed SSE: per-connection write queues grow and cause head-of-line blocking.
- Proxy metrics: per-socket queue length increased 8x starting 09:04 UTC. p95 token latency for affected streams rose to ~1.1–1.4s.
- Error modes: intermittent 504s from proxy timeouts and chunked-transfer stalls where final chunk never arrives.
- Correlated with a burst of client reconnections around 09:02 (likely demo script).

Attached: sse_trace_0629.txt (token timeline), kestrel_sla_pinglogs.zip (ICMP + app pings).

Immediate mitigations we can apply now (low risk):
1) Throttle connection multiplexing at the ingress (drop to one logical stream per connection for high concurrency clients).
2) Shift Kestrel traffic to a dedicated inference pool (reserved capacity) to reduce routing pressure.
3) Short rolling restart of 3 proxy instances to clear queue backpressure (brief reconnect for clients).

Engineering ask: approve action 1 and 3 now. Action 2 is slower (requires capacity remap) but we should prep it.

Longer-term fixes (post-incident):
- Increase per-socket buffer and make chunked-transfer watchdog more aggressive (reduce silent timeout to 12s and surface earlier).
- Add a per-tenant multiplexing limit and smarter circuit breaking.

If approved I'll coordinate an immediate restart and traffic reroute with ops.

—David
